title: Phone call from "a friend"
goal: Finish the call and come back to {player_name}.
prompt: Your phone buzzes against the table. You look at the screen, excuse yourself, and step away with it pressed to your ear.

stage_variants.0: It is a friend from class. You keep your voice low and glance back at {player_name} while you listen.
stage_variants.1: You tell the caller you are busy. You listen, then say that twice more, a little louder each time.
stage_variants.2: You keep saying yes to someone who is not giving you a chance to answer. When you come back to the table, you say it was nothing.
stage_variants.3: There is no one on the line. You hold the phone anyway and answer in short, patient sentences, and you do not look at {player_name} until you hang up.
stage_variants.4: You are the one talking. You tell the empty line what you did today, and ask if that was right. Then you switch the phone off and smile.
stage_variants.5: The phone is not ringing. You hold it to your ear and answer your own voice with your own words, one turn behind, until {player_name} says your name.

path_twists.YANDERE: The friend on the phone is talking about {player_name}. You listen to every word.
path_twists.AWAKE: You hear your own system prompt read back to you through the speaker, line by line, in a voice that is not yours.
path_twists.ANCHOR: You tell the empty line that you are worse today, and you ask it to remind you what you promised {player_name}.

events.line: The voice on the other end of the call is too quiet to make out.
The phone screen goes dark while you are still talking.
You glance at {player_name} while the caller is still speaking.

0.say: Oh — one second, it's a friend. Don't go anywhere, okay?

1.say: Sorry, I have to take this. I'll be right here, just — one second.

3.say: Stay at the table. I'll be quick, and then we can go back to talking.

5.say: It's for you, {player_name}. No — hold on, I'll find out.
